Scope.summary: Telegram Mini App + Telegram Bot + Fastify backend + Next.js CRM architecture for diagnostics, exercises, subscription control, medical-safe retention, high-conversion funnel automation, and iOS-glass medical minimal UX.

DF-001.name: OnboardingFlow
DF-001.path: BOT_ENTRY -> TMA_ENTRY -> TMA_DIAGNOSTIC_WIZARD -> API_GATEWAY -> DOMAIN_DIAGNOSTICS -> DOMAIN_MOVECOINS -> TMA_VIDEO_ENGINE
DF-001.success-criteria: Diagnostic persisted and one-time +20 MC onboarding reward assigned.

DF-002.name: EconomyFlow
DF-002.success-criteria: MoveCoins accrual/debit is idempotent and reflected in user balance.

DF-003.name: MedicalSafetyFlow
DF-003.success-criteria: Red-flag users are blocked from heavy training and escalated to CRM queue.

DF-004.name: SubscriptionGateFlow
DF-004.success-criteria: Expired users are restricted from heavy level with renewal prompt.

DF-005.name: CRMContentFlow
DF-005.success-criteria: New media/text content is published without client rebuild.

DF-006.name: ConversionCampaignFlow
DF-006.path: CRM_SUBSCRIPTION_MANAGER -> CAMPAIGN_ORCHESTRATOR -> BOT_NOTIFICATION_ENGINE -> API_GATEWAY -> DOMAIN_SUBSCRIPTIONS -> TMA_ENTRY
DF-006.success-criteria: Segmented offer sequence is delivered with server-timed deadlines and conversion outcomes are attributed.

DF-007.name: LocalizationResolutionFlow
DF-007.success-criteria: Resolved locale consistently drives UI strings and localized content payloads.

DF-008.name: PanicEscalationFlow
DF-008.success-criteria: One-tap panic action immediately creates escalation and alerts operator channel.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Initialize Telegram Mini App context, validate initData token, and resolve deep-link start routes.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Startup handshake, session bootstrap, locale initialization, route decision for exercise/SOS paths.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Collect zone/VAS/symptoms/red-flag answers and submit structured diagnostic payloads.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Question flow, local state, payload validation, submit and recovery states.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Play exercise videos with subtitles/timers, emit completion events, and expose one-tap panic escalation.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Media playback UX, progress tracking, completion event emission, Panic Button action.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Render progress analytics (VAS and mobility trends) for user feedback.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Charts, trend summaries, period filters, and calm glass-based visual hierarchy.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Receive Telegram updates and dispatch commands/events to bot modules.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Webhook/long-poll setup, update parsing, command routing.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Schedule and deliver retention and conversion notifications with retry/backoff, anti-spam policy, and deterministic funnel scripts.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Reminder triggers, weekly reports, reward announcements, deadline campaign waves, scripted sequence steps, delivery retries.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Generate inline progress cards using fm command payload.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Inline query parser, rendering payload assembly, fallback messaging.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Provide guided Q/A via approved Osteoclinic knowledge with safety restrictions.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Prompt policy, provider adapter, answer filtering, fallback responses.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Expose validated HTTP endpoints for TMA, bot, and CRM clients.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Routing, auth middleware, rate limit, validation, error mapping.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Manage user profile, lifecycle stage, and mobility index updates.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Read/write user profile and profile-derived domain rules.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Persist diagnostic outcomes and derive clinical risk state.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Input normalization, red-flag evaluation hooks, historical retrieval.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Serve exercise catalog with level and policy-aware filtering.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Catalog retrieval, difficulty filtering, media metadata composition.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Apply accrual/debit rules with balance invariants and actionId idempotency guarantees.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Ledger mutations, reward rules, Prisma transaction boundary, anti-duplicate processing by actionId key.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Resolve subscription status and enforce access policies.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Plan lifecycle, status checks, entitlement evaluation.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Apply mandatory medical safety gate and trigger escalation workflows.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Risk rule engine, training lock state, escalation task creation.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Provide persistence adapters for users, diagnostics, exercises, transactions, and subscriptions.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Repository interfaces, Prisma queries, transactional boundaries.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Manage media storage uploads and signed URL generation through Supabase.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Upload policy, path strategy, signed URL issuance, TTL enforcement.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Authenticate CRM operators and bootstrap protected admin routes.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Session gating, role checks, route-level permissions.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Support TG_ID-based search and full diagnostic/activity inspection.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: User list/detail, diagnostic timeline, escalation status view.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Handle subscription access, promo actions, campaign timelines, and bonus MoveCoins grants.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Subscription updates, promo code actions, segmented campaign setup, reminder frequency caps, bonus transaction UI.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Orchestrate campaign enrollment, finite-step transitions, proven high-conversion script order, and suppression policies for medical-risk users.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Enrollment lifecycle, step transition validation, idempotency keys, red-flag suppression, attribution event emission, canonical deadline enforcement.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Resolve locale for API payloads and UI contexts using user preference and request headers.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Locale negotiation, fallback chain, persistence updates from bot /start events.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Provide prominent one-tap emergency escalation entry from exercise screens.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Panic CTA UI, confirmation handling, escalation trigger call, temporary local lock state.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Block campaign notifications and conversion steps for users with medical suppression states.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Suppression policy checks by medicalStatus before send/step execution, audit reason emission.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Upload exercise media and edit diagnostic texts without redeployment.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Content CRUD, upload workflow, publish state controls.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Expose business, funnel, and clinical dashboards (DAU/MAU, revenue, conversion, avg VAS).
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Metric rendering, date filters, cohort breakdowns, campaign-step conversion views.

MODULE_CONTRACT.PURPOSE: Provide unified audit logging and trace evidence for security and domain events.
MODULE_CONTRACT.SCOPE: Log schemas, marker helpers, correlation and redaction utilities.

Phase-1.name: Foundation
Phase-1.why: Establishes runtime, data layer, and authenticated entry points required by all downstream modules.

Phase-2.name: ClinicalCore
Phase-2.why: Introduces diagnostic capture and non-negotiable medical safety guardrails early.

Phase-3.name: EconomyAndSubscriptions
Phase-3.why: Enables exercise access control and MoveCoins economy once safety core is live.

Phase-4.name: BotIntelligence
Phase-4.why: Adds retention and conversion campaign orchestration plus concierge capabilities over validated backend contracts.

Phase-5.name: CRMOperations
Phase-5.why: Completes operator workflows, campaign control surfaces, and user-facing/funnel analytics.

Phase-6.name: Hardening
Phase-6.why: Finalizes media security, performance, and reliability checks before production scale.

UiImplementationTargets.objective: Translate UiContract tokens and component rules into concrete TMA and CRM implementation surfaces.

DeliveryNotes.note-1: All critical CTA controls stay visible within first viewport on core conversion and safety screens.
DeliveryNotes.note-2: When blur support is unavailable, fallback to opaque elevated surfaces from UiContract.
DeliveryNotes.note-3: UrgencyBanner text always reads server-sourced deadline from campaign orchestration APIs.
DeliveryNotes.note-4: Red-flag state visually overrides promotional blocks and routes to support-safe actions.
